lastCompletedStory.title: Sidecar-liveness watcher with sidecarAlive() composite, bounded respawn, and escalate-on-exhaustion

nextStoryContext: US-002 added the second producer for the shared .cam-sidecar-stalled.json marker (US-001's module, src/supervisor/sidecar-stalled.ts, unchanged): a new internal subcommand `cam sidecar-liveness-watch` (src/commands/sidecar-liveness-watch.ts) polls the new sidecarAlive(claudeDir) composite (src/supervisor/sidecar-pid.ts, mirrors watcherAlive) and, on a dead sidecar, attempts a bounded respawn (default 3 attempts, 2s backoff) via a pure handleOneTick(deps, state) tick helper; on exhaustion it writes the marker with reason:'sidecar-died' and latches an 'exhausted' state that self-clears the instant the sidecar is observed alive again (no special-case recovery detection needed). Spawn wiring lives in src/commands/run.ts, gated by the new exported shouldSpawnSidecarLivenessWatch(configPath?) helper (reads worker_isolation via readWorkerIsolation; container-only, no-op in host mode -- this repo is host mode per scripts/cam/project.toml, so the live spawn path is never exercised in dogfood, only unit-tested). Pid persistence/cleanup follows the existing SIDECAR_PID_FILE/WATCHER_PID_FILE pattern: new SIDECAR_LIVENESS_WATCHER_PID_FILE ('.cam-sidecar-liveness-watcher.pid') with write/read/remove/removeIfExists helpers, wired into run.ts's spawn+cleanup block and stop.ts's kill leg (new StopReport.sidecarLivenessWatcherKilled field). The subcommand is registered in index.ts's dispatch switch (case 'sidecar-liveness-watch') and does NOT register --permission-mode (verified: test/no-permission-mode-flag.test.ts still passes; that file only scans index.ts + behaviorally probes the *Args parsers, it does not scan src/commands/ directory contents despite the story notes' mention -- worth confirming with a repo-wide grep if a future story relies on that scan existing). No downstream story dependency is known yet for this marker's consumer side (US-001's boot-time orchestrator surfacing in templates/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md already reads BOTH reason values generically, so no further template change is needed unless the surfaced field shape changes).
